_comment: Human-confirmed matches between BambooHR employees and Harvest users.
Copy to overrides.json. Only add an entry after YOU have verified the
pairing -- this file is the one way a match can be made without an
exact work-email match, and a wrong entry adjusts the wrong person's
balance. 'confirmed_by' is required and is the audit trail.

manual_matches.note: Harvest account is under a personal address from before the domain migration
